title: Mixed Event — Yesteryear Read-Aloud — Episode7 Working as One

meta.Event Outline: Honami volunteers to read a picture book at a neighborhood association event. To help keep the kids' attention, she asks Nene for training in voice acting.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you all for sitting down.
Now, let's get into the story.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
It's titled “The Star-Chasing Dog”.
And it's about...

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: Hey, let's play a word game.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I wish there were some way for us to get them to focus on the stage...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, okay.
Let's give it a try.

rows.Speaker: Association Executive B
rows.Line: Settle down, children! What happened to the zippers on our mouths?

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: Hey, did you watch that anime?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wait, did you hear something just now?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
What was that? It sounded like a dog...
Can you guys hear it?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's strange. I could've sworn I heard one just now...

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: What would something like that be doing here?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I don't know, but... Oh, there it is again!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Okay, they're all looking at Kusanagi now.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Now I just need to hit the remote...!)

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: Huh? Now it's coming from over there!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Can you all see where the doggy is?

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line:
No.
I can hear it, but I can't see it...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, there it is again.
But where could it be...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Where? Hmm... I'm still not seeing it...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, the doggy's tail is making a shadow on the screen!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Hey, you're right!
What's it doing here?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
What if...?
Was he so excited that he decided to jump out of the book?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
We're really sorry!
It'll be your turn soon, so just bear with us for a bit longer, okay?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Don't worry.
He's waiting very patiently for us in this book.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. It's a story about a very kind dog with a very fluffy tail.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Don't you all want to see him again?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Great.
Then, can you all listen quietly while we read this story to you?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. Your acting was so convincing, Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I wouldn't call what I did just now acting...
If anything, your quick thinking is what saved us.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I never would've thought to use the sound recordings and the shadow trick we prepared to get the kids' attention.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <As with any live performance, it's normal to have a lot of things go through your mind...>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Chiefly, whether or not all the hard work you put in is going to pay off.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<But I'm sure you two will do just fine.
So, go out there and have as much fun as the children are about to.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Somebody told me she was sure we'd do a good job...
I think we have her to thank.
